svg.title: Accounts and locked lamports per data band
svg.desc: Seven rows, one per data length band. Bars show the account count in each band; the two right columns show the count and the lamports held as exemptions. The 1M and above band, two accounts, holds 22,167,121,248 lamports and carries the copper accent. The 100-999 band holds 58,630,914 lamports across 26 accounts, and the 1k-9.9k band holds 125,545,392 across 8.
